sections.body: Receiving begins the traceability record for goods. Match the order number or shipping reference, item name, counting unit, quantity, and recipient to the documents. sections.body: Check one lot at a time so goods for two orders are not mixed. Scan the label or record the number accurately, then mark receipt according to procedure. If a label cannot be read or documents are missing, place the goods in the designated hold area and ask staff to inspect them. Case: the order number on the label differs from the receiving sheet. Response: do not add the goods to active stock until the discrepancy is confirmed.

sections.body: Use the hold status or quarantine area required by warehouse rules. Take photographs only when instructions permit. Do not open special packaging or remove labels without direction. sections.body: Match the item code and location before putting goods away. Make sure labels face outward or are positioned so they can be read, and do not block inspection routes. Anyone who is available

sections.body: Stop moving goods from a location being counted if procedure requires it. Check the unit, item number, and recent transactions; ask authorized staff to approve any correction. sections.body: Picking retrieves stock to fulfill an order. A list or scanner shows the item, quantity, location, and applicable selection rules. Items with similar names may not be the same. sections.body: Match the item code and location before picking, count using the specified unit, and confirm the transaction with the work device. objectives: Mencocokkan kiriman, tujuan, dan jumlah sebelum serah terima.
Mencatat siapa atau bagian mana yang menerima kiriman sesuai prosedur.
Menjaga status tetap terbuka ketika bukti serah belum tersedia.
lessons.response: Stop closing the transaction, recount, record the one package left behind, and coordinate whether it should be sent separately or held.
lessons.scenario: The list shows eight packages, but the carrier is taking seven.

sections.body: The outbound stage ensures that picked and packed goods are handed to the carrier or next process for the correct destination. Handover documents, package count, shipment number, and time form part of the goods' traceability record. Document names and signature methods vary by facility; use the designated system.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Match packages to the list before handover. Record quantity differences or damage before the vehicle leaves the area. Do not mark goods as received without confirmation. Case: the list shows eight packages, but the carrier takes only seven. Response: keep the status open, recount, and ask the carrier and staff to confirm the package left behind.

lessons.caution: Do not change a product's function or specifications, or substitute items in a set, without authorization.

checks.explanation: A warehouse may prepare goods for distribution, but it does not change a product's function or specifications.
options: Apply labels or assemble sets according to instructions
Change the product's capabilities or function
Repair the production machine
Change the product contents based on an estimate
checks.prompt: What is an example of a light distribution process in a warehouse?

checks.explanation: The set's contents must match the instructions; substitutions require an authorized decision and accurate records.
options: Replace it with a similar item without asking
Write that the set is complete
Hold the order and report the shortage for a staff decision
Take it from another order
checks.prompt: One of the three types required for a set is unavailable. What should you do?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Read the process instructions and order identity → Check the available contents and quantity → Perform only the specified distribution process → Check the label and record the result.
options: Read the process instructions and order identity
Check the available contents and quantity
Perform only the specified distribution process
Check the label and record the process result

dialogue.meaning: One item is missing. Please check.
dialogue.reading: ひとつたりません。かくにんをおねがいします。

objectives: Membedakan proses distribusi ringan dari pembuatan atau perubahan fungsi produk.
Mengikuti instruksi untuk pelabelan, set, atau pengemasan ulang.
Mempertahankan identitas barang dan catatan sebelum serta setelah proses.
lessons.response: Hold the kitting process, record which products are present and missing, and ask staff whether to locate stock or delay the order.
lessons.scenario: The instruction calls for a set of three products, but the third type cannot be found.

sections.body: Warehouse work may include light distribution tasks such as dividing quantities into smaller packages, applying labels, or assembling several items into an order set. These tasks prepare goods for distribution. Changes that create or enhance a product's function are manufacturing activities and are outside this warehouse practice.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Before starting, confirm the instructions, item number, quantity in each package, materials, and labels to be used. Keep the product and previous label traceable under procedure. Do not change the product contents, specifications, or description on your own. Case: the instruction calls for a set of three items, but only two types are available. Response: do not substitute the third type; hold the order and report the shortage.

lessons.caution: Do not move or mark goods without updating their location and status.

checks.explanation: Update the location and status so the goods remain findable and traceable.
options: The goods' identity and quantity, old and new locations, and reason or status
The worker's name only
An estimate without a record
There is no need to record it if it is temporary
checks.prompt: What information must be communicated when goods are moved for weather protection?

checks.explanation: Protection must follow safety instructions, and every movement must be recorded for traceability.
options: Move all items to the aisle without recording them
Close off the area and say nothing
Report it to the supervisor and follow the plan; record any items moved
Use wet cardboard to cover it
checks.prompt: Water is starting to enter near the rack. What is the correct action?

checks.explanation: Workflow taught: Identify and report the exception and its location → Follow the instructed protective action → Record the movement, quantity, and item status → Hand open issues over to the next worker.
options: Identify and report the exception and its location
Follow the instructed protective action
Record the movement, quantity, and item status
Hand open issues over to the next worker

dialogue.reading: たなのちかくにみずがはいっています。

dialogue.meaning: I will report it to staff and wait for instructions.
dialogue.reading: たんとうしゃにほうこくして、しじをまちます。

objectives: Melaporkan kerusakan, lokasi, dan transaksi yang belum selesai dengan jelas.
Membantu penataan dan perlindungan barang sesuai arahan saat cuaca buruk.
Menyerahkan status persediaan dan hambatan kepada giliran berikutnya.
lessons.response: Report the location and conditions to a supervisor, follow the warehouse protection plan, and record every box moved and its new location.
lessons.scenario: Water is starting to enter near the racks, and several boxes are on a low level.

sections.body: Warehouses rely on reports to keep goods traceable through receiving, storage, picking, and dispatch. Record spills, water ingress, roof leaks, missing labels, or system outages along with the location and safe actions taken. As severe weather approaches, the facility plan may call for moving goods or protecting areas from rain.
sections.title: Work Concepts

sections.body: Follow the person in charge's instructions and do not move sensitive goods without recording the new location. Report an incident immediately; at handover, explain the lot, rack, quantity, status, time, and any action still needed. Case: water is starting to enter near a rack. Response: notify a supervisor, protect yourself, and move goods only when directed through a safe procedure; record the new location.
